newsitem.title: USA: AmeriCredit files $1 bln shelf registration.
newsitem.headline: AmeriCredit files $1 bln shelf registration.

text.p: AmeriCredit Financial Services Inc, a unit of AmeriCredit Corp, filed a shelf registration Monday with the Securities and Exchange Commission for up to $1.0 billion in asset-backed securities.
The securities will be backed by receivables from auto loan instalments.
The securities to be sold will represent ownership in a segregated pool of assets of a trust, including auto retail instalment sales contracts.
Based in Fort Worth, Texas, AFS buys and services automobile loans which are originated and assigned to AFS by automobile dealers.
